strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs after sell-side liquidity is grabbed, and for shorts after buy-side liquidity is grabbed.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity-grab wick/level. Take profit at the most recent opposing swing level: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; examples shown on mixed charts
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Directly use the candle that made the liquidity grab as the entry reference
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Wait for the indicator's marked entry signal after it identifies the liquidity grab
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: the indicator marks the liquidity grab for us it starts to Mark the entry point and the signal to enter

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one reversal skeleton only; mentions of 10-candle spacing, divergence, and higher-timeframe support/resistance are confluence filters to improve the same strategy, not separate strategies.
